description: We are Team Neural Nexus, five students building SoilVerity for the Field Shift challenge: a tool that compares crop rotations using NASA data and tells farmers how far to trust the advice. Our skills: Python, FastAPI, React, data processing and rule-based decision engines. We are looking for: agronomy or soil science knowledge, NASA data experience (POWER, SMAP, IMERG) and UI/UX design. Join us to turn Earth data into practical farm decisions.
